goal14Baseline.note: Counts are directional only; the Goal 15 scan used a separately downloaded database artifact.

notableFindings.status: remediated by AL2023 package updates; the derived image has 0 critical and 0 high findings

assessmentLimitations: Remote upstream high and medium findings need package-owner triage; scanner severity alone does not establish reachability or exploitability.
Locally built images have resolved content digests in this record but Compose still names them with mutable local tags.
Mailpit is development-profile only and is not a production dependency.

remediationHistory.action: Derived image from the digest-pinned AWS CLI 2.37.4 image and upgraded AL2023 packages from the base snapshot to release 2023.12.20261013. Trivy high findings fell from 16 to 0.
Updated to upstream Grafana 13.2.4. Critical/high counts are unchanged; medium fell from 15 to 14 and low from 2 to 1.

Rebuilt the pinned upstream SeaweedFS 4.48 source commit with the pinned Go 1.26.9 builder and golang.org/x/net v0.60.0, then copied the binary into the digest-pinned upstream runtime image. Trivy high IDs fell from 3 to 0.

verification.trivy: 0 critical, 0 high, 2 medium, 0 low, 1 unknown; database artifact unchanged from the Goal 15 baseline scan.
verification.syntheticS3Smoke: Passed health, bucket creation, put-object, get-object, and byte-for-byte SHA-256 comparison using temporary storage and an isolated network namespace.
verification.distribution: Local build only. Publish through the approved image registry, rescan that registry artifact, and update Compose to its immutable registry digest before deployment.
